text:
nate: FYI — Helios Labs got double-billed on their Dedicated pool for March. Seeing both a regular usage line and a duplicate burst charge. Need a one-time credit + net30 on the invoice. Invoice: INV-2026-0423, Account: HEL-8842. total overcharge ~ $18,450.

sophia: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the invoice lines (screenshot or text) and confirm whether the burst was requested by sales? We need cause + amount before any credit.

nate: pasted snippet below:
```
2026-03-01 DEDICATED-MONTHLY Helios Labs    $120,000
2026-03-15 DEDICATED-BURST Helios Labs      $18,450
2026-03-15 DEDICATED-BURST Helios Labs      $18,450  <-- duplicate
```
They only requested one burst on 3/15 (confirmed by maya). Looks like billing job re-run.

maya: confirmed — we submitted a one-off burst for a migration on 3/15. Sales didn't request anything extra. This is definitely a platform duplicate. Customer is on annual Dedicated (reserved) with monthly burst allowance.

sophia: OK, so root cause = platform retry produced duplicate charge. Per process: credits <= $15k can be approved by finance ops, >$15k need finance lead sign-off. This is $18,450, so tagging @omar for approval.

omar: thanks. Quick Q: has CS (lea) confirmed the customer is active and not disputing other items? Also confirm we won't need contract amendments.

lea: CS confirmed Helios wants invoice corrected and credit applied. No contract changes needed, they just need clean billing + net30 on the corrected invoice.

omar: I can approve a one-time credit of $18,450 and a 30-day payment term on the corrected invoice as an exception. Please include a short note in the credit memo referencing the duplicate-billing root cause and link to the internal postmortem ticket.

sophia: Great — will create the credit note and route to AR. finance-bot, create credit note and update invoice terms (net30).

finance-bot: Created credit note CN-1845001 for INV-2026-0423 amount $18,450. Invoice updated to Net 30. Linked ticket: BILL-2317.

nate: Sending to Helios Ops now with the CN attached and updated due date. Maya/Lea — I'll cc you on the message.

maya: thanks. I'll add a brief note to the incident (BILL-2317) on the billing retry root cause and tag eng-runtime to ensure the dedupe check is added to the job.

sophia: Documenting approval here per audit: one-time credit approved by @omar for $18,450 due to duplicate platform charge. No contract change. Action items: 1) credit note CN-1845001 issued, 2) invoice INV-2026-0423 updated to Net 30, 3) incident BILL-2317 created and assigned to eng-runtime.

omar: approved :thumbsup:

lea: customer notified, they acknowledged and said thanks. Closing the loop.

nate: closing thread.
